entities.title: The status line
entities.summary: A document under the convention says so in one line at the top, linking to this repository, and never restates the legend.
consumers: Documents in repositories that adopted knowledge-driven development
guarantees: The repository's URL leads to the definition of the four marks, so a document that links here needs no legend of its own.
The definition lives here once; adopting repositories link to it rather than copying it.
entities.compatibility: The README says the repository stays as it was written, and repositories that adopted the convention can keep following it.
